description: Spec §6.1, §3: with NPCCount 1, SpawnNPCs gives the NPC's car MI_DF_Paint_Gang on Body slot 0, the gang's flame-orange MI_DF_Trim_Gang on slot 1 and no light bar (the player's car alone has one); wrecked, both slots turn MI_DF_Paint_Charred, and the NPC is back 2.5 s later in a fresh car with the same gang look. The NPCs are despawned and NPCCount set back to 0 on every finish.
